failed.detail: The camera is more elevated than production Ashfang, but the long side silhouette still dominates instead of exposing a convincing approximately 55-degree gameplay view of top planes and foot placement.

Only three feet remain trackable after deterministic preparation; the far-side fourth limb is swallowed by the chest and near foreleg mass, so this master cannot define unambiguous diagonal walk support ownership.
Aspect-preserving safe-box preparation projects the 236x197 source ink to roughly 118x98.5 runtime pixels, above the current 72-86 pixel isolated-master height window.
Bright plate rims and dense high-frequency highlights remain glossier and louder than the restrained Cinderwake gameplay material target at runtime size.
The normalized keyed creature is about 53.5 percent of canvas height, below the requested 58-68 percent range even though its width and foot baseline are close to target.
The generated magenta background is visibly graded rather than one flat literal #ff00ff value.

evaluation.notes: Isolation materially improved the world camera, compact living silhouette, and centered support base, but the missing fourth readable limb and oversized runtime height veto use as an identity master.

preparation.notes: Uniform aspect-preserving placement produces a compact 236x197 source placement box ending at the declared foot anchor; visible keyed ink ends one pixel high. Raster preparation cannot reveal the occluded fourth limb or reduce authored highlight density, and independent per-pose safe-fit remains diagnostic rather than a multi-frame scale contract.

acceptedAxes: readable silhouette, eye, and ember core at runtime scale
rejectedAxes: identity continuity of head, armor complexity, and tail
restrained matte material and highlight density
all four limbs and feet readable
suitability for explicit diagonal support ownership

recommendation: Stop after this master and do not generate walk phases. A v3 master must keep the elevated compact posture while exposing all four feet, reducing glossy highlight density, and fitting the shared runtime-height window before the isolated-pose assembler is used.
